addr: 9th Main Road, 4th Cross Rd, HAL 2nd Stage, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560008, India

rev.t: Recently attended a function in one of their open venues and learnt a bit about the club. …

Attended India Jazz project here. The experience was truly amazing. It's quite spacious. The only downside is that there's no parking facility available. Still, it can be ignored if you are commuting via public transport. Food and drinks were overpriced as usual in any concerts. However, cocktails are must try.
Nice place to conduct events. Parking inside the club is allowed only for Members. On 14-June-2026, our community Annual meeting was held here
